identity.problem: hot-rolling mill work-roll cooling spray system: cooling nozzle clogging causes non-uniform roll temperature and strip shape defects

mechanism.mechanism: cascade filtration with differential-pressure monitoring and automatic backflush of the cooling header, staged so the roll-face spray header sees constant supply pressure and flow distribution across the full spray bar length
mechanism.intervention: two-stage wedge-wire cascade (300 micron then 120 micron) on the recirculated cooling-water supply, each stage with a dP transmitter and a pigging-free automatic backflush valve arrangement, sized for the mill's declared duty point
mechanism.expected_effect: nozzle-clogging events per campaign reduced from the baseline 4.1 (scheduled manual cleaning at roll changes) to below 0.5, with roll thermal-crown variation held inside the declared 12 micron band across a full rolling campaign

identity.novelty_hypothesis: the backflush-at-dP-threshold arrangement on the spray header (not the mill supply) is the novel design variable

engineering.assumptions: fixture: supply water scale load bounded by the declared recirculation class
engineering.constraints: no mill stop for retrofit; recirculated water with scale particles present
causal_chain: staged filtration removes scale above 120 um
dP rise triggers backflush before nozzle-channel bridging
constant header pressure keeps the spray distribution uniform
roll thermal crown stays inside the declared band

shortlist: campaign-scale clogging count with and without the cascade at the declared duty point
decisive_experiment.selected: campaign-scale clogging count with and without the cascade at the declared duty point
decisive_experiment.explanation: fixture: the cheapest measurement that can kill the mechanism

falsification_contract.hypothesis: staged header-side filtration with dP-triggered backflush keeps nozzle-clogging events below 0.5 per campaign
falsification_contract.treatment: cascade installed on the spray header supply
falsification_contract.control: the installed baseline (scheduled manual cleaning at roll changes)
falsification_contract.measurement: nozzle-clogging events per rolling campaign, counted by the mill's own spray-pattern inspection
falsification_contract.acceptance_threshold: clogging events per campaign <= 0.5 on the treatment arm
falsification_contract.falsification_threshold: clogging events per campaign >= 4 on the treatment arm (no improvement on the baseline count)
